entities.name: Khone
entities.description: Swamp kingdom in Golthonor on Corondor, once an enchanted forest.

entities.name: Sol'Kanar
entities.description: Bound spirit of Khone's forest who enforced tribute and retreated into the swamp.

entities.name: Geyadrone Dihada
entities.description: Planeswalker who twisted Khone into a swamp and bound its spirit.

entities.name: Dakkon Blackblade
entities.description: Summoned to Sedouris; enslaved to Dihada's will.

entities.name: Chondaeh
entities.description: Young sorceress of Shikar who boiled the swamp around Khone.

entities.name: Sivitri Scarzam
entities.description: Fought Sol'Kanar in an ancient war.

entities.name: Sedouris
entities.description: Ancient city destroyed by a Cosmic Horror and made Dihada's lair.

entities.name: House Jet
entities.description: Ruling house of the rebuilt realm by 4196 AR.

entities.name: Blackblade-Dihada War
entities.description: War with first battles in Khone.

events.summary: Dihada twists Khone into a swamp and binds its spirit as Sol'Kanar.
events.quote: until it was twisted into a swamp by Geyadrone Dihada and its spirit was bound to her service as Sol'Kanar the Swamp King

events.summary: After five years of siege by Sol'Kanar, Dihada summons a Cosmic Horror to eradicate Sedouris.
events.quote: Dihada summoned a Cosmic Horror to eradicate the inhabitants of the city

events.summary: Carth summons Dakkon to Sedouris; Dihada destroys the city, and Dakkon regains his shadow but is enslaved to her.
events.quote: Dakkon regaining his shadow but also becoming enslaved to Dihada's will

events.summary: Sol'Kanar forces the kingdoms to send tribute until the Dragon War.
events.quote: forced the inhabitants to send slaves and goods on the Date of Tribute

events.summary: Chondaeh boils the swamp, killing everyone in Khone but Gydolien Mor; Sol'Kanar retreats.
events.quote: killing everyone there, with Gydolien Mor as the only survivor

events.summary: By 4196 AR Khone is rebuilt as a small realm ruled by House Jet.
events.quote: Khone had been rebuilt as a small realm ruled by House Jet

relations.quote: its spirit was bound to her service as Sol'Kanar the Swamp King
also becoming enslaved to Dihada's will
Greatly weakened by the loss of much of his magic, Sol'Kanar retreated into the swamp to bide his time.
